clips.title: The story
paras: The Fang of Githyiss is a rare and formidable specimen taken from a giant arachnid stalking the wilds near Aldrassil. Delivering the fang to a naturalist in the sanctuary allows scholars to study the monstrous creature and monitor the predatory threats nesting within Shadowglen.

The Fang of Githyiss is a trophy and biological sample harvested from the overgrown spider Githyiss, who lurks in the wilds of Shadowglen. A beast of such notable bulk poses a clear threat to young travelers venturing out from Aldrassil, making the recovery of its fang both a matter of safety and scientific interest. Rather than letting the creature's remains rot in the underbrush, resourceful scouts take the specimen back to the sanctuary of the great tree.

Within Aldrassil, night elf naturalists and scholars keep close track of the wildlife roaming the forest floor. Presenting a fresh, intact fang from a creature of Githyiss's magnitude provides crucial insight into the arachnid populations flourishing beneath Teldrassil's canopy. The local researchers welcome such unexpected discoveries, utilizing the massive fang to further their ongoing studies into the aggressive fauna of the glade.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My, my. How I do love surprises, friend.
This specimen will surely help further my studies.
